purpose: Provide a meaningful, strictly controlled RED reproduction probe for redundant overlapping CallLifecycleService reconciliation causing actual room-lock queue pressure and PG statement timeouts (57014), prior to any bounded performance sourcefix.

native61.failure: Third actor Ha stayed in initial room-loading; original 5s region visibility failed. Observers removed did NOT remedy contention.

candidateInternalDesign.concept: Per-group coalescing of ordinary reconcile triggers only
candidateInternalDesign.mechanism: While a reconciliation pass is in-flight for call group G, subsequent triggers for group G set a pending flag and accumulate screen-ended events, scheduling exactly ONE trailing pass upon completion.
candidateInternalDesign.boundedWorkGuarantee: For N concurrent triggers on group G, at most 2 reconciliation passes occur (1 in-flight + 1 trailing pass), reducing room-lock queue pressure from O(N) to O(1).
candidateInternalDesign.freshReadGuarantee: Trailing pass executes fresh LiveKit SFU listRooms/listParticipants RPCs and fresh PostgreSQL transaction, guaranteeing eventual fresh state evaluation after all triggers.
candidateInternalDesign.screenShareSafety: All screen-ended {identity, at} event pairs are accumulated and passed to publishing.reconcileWithin, ensuring no track unpublish event is dropped.

invariants.roomLockMode: SELECT id FROM rooms WHERE id=$1 FOR UPDATE (strictly unchanged)
invariants.groupLockMode: SELECT id,room_id,state FROM call_groups WHERE id=$1 FOR UPDATE (strictly unchanged)
invariants.transactionBoundary: Network RPCs and database mutations remain within canonical transaction boundaries
invariants.actorValidation: actor() and liveLease() checks strictly preserved
invariants.eventProcessing: No event is ignored or dropped
